accuracy.evidence: Checked NC Y3 flowering-plant life cycle (pollination, seed formation, seed dispersal) and NGSS 2-LS2-2 pollination/dispersal model ideas; anther→stigma wording.

misconceptions.evidence: Checked traps: flowers only decoration; pollination=germination; seeds need not move; pollen made in roots/leaves.

lab_distinct.evidence: Checked flagpollin: anther→stigma→seed→dispersal modes; not flagseed (germination), flagplant (parts), flagsprout, flagcycle diagrams alone.

lab_teaches.evidence: Checked: learner dusts anther, moves pollen to stigma, forms seed, picks dispersal, spots decoration myth, orders the story.

predictions.evidence: Checked tempting wrongs on pollen place, pollination definition, seed-after-pollination, why disperse, decoration myth, and order.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Checked why() splits root/leaf pollen myths, germination mix-ups, decoration-only, stay-on-parent, and order errors.

readability.evidence: Checked ages 7–8 kid lines use pollen / stigma / seed / travel; adult names NC Y3 and NGSS 2-LS2-2 within family bars.

no_filler.evidence: Checked every sentence teaches pollination, seed formation, dispersal, or a named mix-up — no throat-clearing.

mobile.evidence: Checked flower/dispersal controls with large lbtn twins and tap targets; layout holds near 390 px width.

accessibility.evidence: Checked pollen/stigma/seed/dispersal buttons twin flower canvas taps; live aria-label narrates pollination; challenge uses aria-live status.

sources: UK NC 2013 Science Y3 Plants — role of flowers in the life cycle including pollination, seed formation and seed dispersal
